description: HYBRID FFN-slot (LINEAR variant), PARAMETER-MATCHED to exp032 (35,792,640). The dense 384->1536->384 GELU FFN is REMOVED entirely and the FFN slot becomes two parallel paths summed into the residual -- x = x + linear(h) + fastmhl(h), h = ln2(x). Path A = a SINGLE plain nn.Linear(384->384) with bias (no hidden expansion, no GELU, no second linear); weight zero-init'd for a residual-identity start. Path B = a PLAIN fixed-anchor-pair FastMultiHeadLut (classic FastMHL sign-test addressing -- NOT HyperplaneMHL) with n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, NAP=6, tph=42, HARD forward (full soft-surrogate backward -> grads reach tables AND flow back into h), fp32 (use_bf16=False, matching the fp32 model), near-zero table init (1e-3), per-layer anchor/init seed = 1000 + layer_idx. PARAM MATCH: the removed FFN cost 1,179,648/layer; the replacement costs Linear 147,840 + FastMHL(42*64*384=1,032,192) = 1,180,032/layer (+384/layer = the Linear bias). tph=42 was chosen so total = 35,794,944, delta +2,304 = +0.0064% vs exp032 (best achievable with this Linear; any NAP with tph*2^NAP=2688 gives the same). Both paths train simultaneously; the second sub-block ~= 0 at init. MATCHED 4096-step A/B against exp032 (byte-identical everything else: MinimalGPT+RoPE, d384/6L/6H/seq512, device_bs 48, total_bs 24576, n_steps 4096, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, eval_every 200, seed 1, vocab 32768, same data). Optimizer: LUT-table weights in the NO-weight-decay AdamW group (project lesson: LUT tables take no wd); the new Linear weight -> wd group, bias -> no-wd; all other params grouped exactly as exp032. Compare final val_bpb against exp032's 1.39371.
